fact: The Central Bank of Sudan's Economic and Financial Statistical Review January-December 2024 (Issue 1/2024, Vol. 64) publishes foreign trade statistics for 2023 and 2024 drawn from the Customs Authority's records, together with Ministry of Oil and Gas and Sudan Electricity Holding Company figures and the UN Comtrade database.
title: العرض الاقتصادي والمالي يناير - ديسمبر 2024 (Economic and Financial Statistical Review, January-December 2024)
publisher: بنك السودان المركزي (Central Bank of Sudan), Policies, Research and Statistics Department
